name: horizontal-1920x1080
description: 16:9 long form (YouTube, web, TV). Full-frame footage, letterbox through rcg cinema, safe-zone text cards, flat text clips.
$comment: Safe zones are a starting assumption, not measured on a player: 5% title-safe margins left and right, the top 54 px clear, and no text in the bottom 12% where a desktop player draws its controls and auto captions. Adjust per platform when the user names one.
